name: Product/Tool
description__value: A tangible good, material, or application developed for widespread adoption and use (e.g., equipment, seeds, sensors, software tool, mobile app). Designed for direct practical application in agrifood systems.

name: Practice/Technique
description__value: A method, approach, or technical procedure (traditional or novel) that can be adopted or applied to improve agrifood system outcomes.

name: Research result
description__value: A solution, method, or technology developed through public or private research with demonstrated potential, but not yet packaged as a commercial product, widespread knowledge product, or scalable service offering.

name: Integrated solution
description__value: A combination or bundle of complementary innovations (products, services, practices, policies) designed to address a complex problem in a coordinated way.

name: Framework/Approach/Methodology
description__value: A structured sequence of actions, procedures, organizational steps techniques designed to deliver a consistent outcome or improvement. Includes social and institutional processes, (E.g., aggregation processes like cooperatives, participatory planning methods, certification processes...) as well as methodologies and theoretical / methodological frameworks.

name: Service
description__value: An innovation delivered as a service offering, providing ongoing support, facilitation, or expertise (e.g., advisory services, extension platforms).

name: Platform
description__value: A digital or physical space or system that connects multiple actors or resources, enabling interaction, knowledge sharing, or transactions (e.g., e-marketplaces, data platforms).

name: Policy
description__value: A formal directive, regulation, policy instrument, or legal framework issued by a government or authoritative body, aimed at enabling or enforcing specific changes or behaviors in agrifood systems. As a form, it refers to the actual policy document or policy measure that can be adopted, applied, or implemented. (This is different from Policy innovations in the Types of innovations taxonomy:

name: Knowledge product
description__value: A packaged, reusable innovation in knowledge, information, or educational content, distinct from research results or services. Includes instructional materials, curricula, databases, visualization systems, handbooks, or media formats that codify and communicate agrifood innovations. The innovation lies in the knowledge packaging, delivery model, or accessible presentation rather than the underlying knowledge alone.
